# Baha Dobay

> Data Scientist at Türk Telekom. Projects on causal inference, agentic
> systems and speech models. This site collects the work, the writing and the
> notes.

## Projects

- [Dodona](https://dodona.bahadobay.dev): a voice-native decision model. Ask
  typed questions about speech (yes/no, multiple choice or a scale) and
  get calibrated probabilities read straight from the audio, with no transcript
  in between. Open weights on
  [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/bahadobay/dodona-audio), Apache-2.0
  [code](https://github.com/bahadobay/dodona-audio), an MCP server and a
  [demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/bahadobay/dodona).
- Crypto Insights Platform: a data pipeline combining on-chain data, LLM-based
  sentiment analysis and anomaly detection, deployed with real-time dashboards.
- NBA Player Career Prediction: a case study on the Oklahoma City Thunder
  predicting career outcomes for veterans and rookies from a large NBA dataset.
